4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGPERSONALROOMENTRANCE_00178_NO_PERMIT_TO_BUY1
4.description: You cannot purchase private chambers until you have attained level 50 in a single class.
4.translation_description: Per acquistare una camera privata, devi aver raggiunto il livello 50 in una classe.

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGPERSONALROOMENTRANCE_00178_NO_PERMIT_TO_BUY2
5.description: Moreover, you must also have attained the rank of second lieutenant in the Maelstrom, the Order of the Twin Adder, or the Immortal Flames.
5.translation_description: Inoltre, devi aver raggiunto il grado di sottotenente nella Tempesta, nell'Ordine della Vipera Gemella o nelle Fiamme Immortali.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGPERSONALROOMENTRANCE_00178_BUY_CONFIRM_TITLE
6.description: Do you wish to purchase your own private chambers for <hex:022206E802FF022C03> gil?<hex:02100103>The purchase price will not be refunded under any circumstances.
6.translation_description: Desideri acquistare una camera privata per <hex:022206E802FF022C03> gil?<hex:02100103>Il prezzo d'acquisto non sarà rimborsato in alcun caso.
